## Product Intelligence - AI Extraction
Reads `pending_ai_extractions`, extracts with OpenRouter (forced tool call), writes through `apply_ai_extraction` (validated, idempotent, one transaction per document). Failures go to `fail_ai_extraction`; source documents are never modified.
**Credentials:** `Nexora Supabase` (supabaseApi, service role) and `OpenRouter API Key` (Header Auth: name `x-api-key`).
Run SQL migration 001 first.
